liturgicalDay.feastOrSaint: Monday of the twentieth week of Ordinary Time

verseOfDay.text: And behold one came and said to him: Good master, what good shall I do that I may have life everlasting?

prayer.title: Saint Thomas Aquinas — Before Work
prayer.text:
Grant me, O Lord my God,
a mind to know thee,
a heart to seek thee,
wisdom to find thee,
conduct pleasing to thee,
faithful perseverance in waiting for thee,
and a hope of finally embracing thee.
Give me a right way of beginning,
a right way of going on,
and a right way of finishing.
Amen.
prayer.note: Aquinas prayed before he wrote. Pray it before you open the truck door.

consider.question: What is purgatory?
consider.answer: The final purification of those who die in God's friendship but are not yet wholly free of the effects of sin. Everyone in purgatory is saved — this is not a second chance and not a lesser hell. It is why the Church prays for the dead, and why that prayer is worth doing.
